product_positioning.tagline: The property operations platform by HawkVision Homes
product_positioning.core_thesis: Preserve the high-end charcoal/obsidian + warm copper/burnt-orange aesthetic while transforming the entire architecture from a sales brokerage into an institutional-grade property operations and rental system.

design_principles.aesthetic: Charcoal/Black foundation (#0D1117, #161B22) with warm linen (#FAF8F5) body, burnt-orange / copper accent (#C25E2B), and deep slate borders. Refined, cinematic, trustworthy, dense when operational.
design_principles.public_vs_internal: The public website feels like a curated, architecturally confident rental showcase with Cincinnati neighborhood context. The internal PerchPoint OS feels dense, precise, data-correlated, and command-center grade with strict hierarchy.
design_principles.anti_ai_rules: No generic centered hero layouts, no generic teal/cyan gradients, no fictional statistics without demonstration badges, no fake agent advisors.
design_principles.demonstration_notice: All portfolio counts, ledgers, and metrics must be explicitly tagged with `Demonstration Portfolio Data • Phase 0 Staging`.

farouk_owner.access_scope: Full portfolio visibility; approval of reserved expenditures, leases, applicants, and legal exceptions. NO production code/database administration or secret rotation.

nathan_super_admin.access_scope: Complete application infrastructure, API integrations, security controls, company-controlled technical email config, RLS policies, developer feature flags.

leasing_manager.access_scope: Portfolio-wide applicant queues, scheduled showings, lease preparations, resident notices, maintenance dispatch.

accounting_contractor.access_scope: Financial reconciliation, rent collection ledgers, vendor invoice clearing, property P&L statements, approved document archive.

maintenance_employee.access_scope: Assigned internal work orders, resident access notes, supply estimates, before/after photographic evidence, routine repair completion up to staff threshold.

subcontractor.access_scope: Strictly assigned jobs, entry pin instructions, job estimate submission, invoice upload, photo evidence submission.

primary_resident.access_scope: Household portal, rent autopay, signed digital lease, maintenance ticket filing with photo uploads, emergency escalation instructions.

applicant.access_scope: Submitted rental application for Unit 412-A, background/credit screening consent tracker, income verification upload, application timeline.

delegation_policy_engine.overview: Multidimensional policy engine that prevents bottlenecking Farouk on trivial purchases while strictly enforcing reserved authority on high-impact outlays.

rules.condition: Routine purchase within property budget and under $250
rules.action: Immediate self-approval with attached digital receipt

rules.escalation: Escalates to Farouk if over monthly category budget

rules.condition: Total repair cost exceeding the unit's monthly rent
rules.action: Notification sent with photo evidence, vendor quote, and 30-day budget delta
rules.escalation: Hard stop until Farouk signs off digitally

rules.condition: Spending outside an approved budget or capital renovation
New lease agreement or applicant qualification waiver
rules.action: Full tenant screening package and lease generation review
rules.escalation: Permanent audit log entry with timestamp

rules.condition: Emergency to protect life or physical building structure (e.g., active water main burst)
rules.action: Immediate emergency dispatch permitted up to $2,000
rules.escalation: Instant SMS alert to Farouk & Retrospective Review within 24 hours

key_sections_to_build.description: HawkVision Homes header branding with 'Powered by PerchPoint OS', navigation links to rentals, apply, maintenance, resident portal, and primary CTA 'Sign in to PerchPoint'.

Bold Cincinnati architectural hero highlighting HawkVision Homes & PerchPoint operations. Quick filter tabs for All Rentals, Single-Family, Multi-Family Duplex/Triplex, and Mixed-Use Commercial. Direct CTA to 'Browse Available Rentals' and 'Schedule a Showing'.

Available rental properties with clear monthly rent, security deposit, utility breakdown, pet policy, qualification guidelines (income 3x rent, 640+ credit, clean background), interactive Showing Scheduler modal trigger, and online application initiation.

Visual interactive display showing the Organization -> Ownership Entity -> Property -> Unit & Shared Assets tree, clearly demonstrating how a mixed-use building has 2 residential units and 1 commercial bakery unit.

Transparent step-by-step application walkthrough: 1. Schedule a Showing, 2. Submit Online PerchPoint Application ($45 FCRA-compliant screening), 3. Income & Rental Verification, 4. Secure Digital Lease Sign & Portal Setup. No hidden broker fees.

Dual-track maintenance hub: 1. Standard Resident Maintenance Request with photo upload simulation, 2. Urgent 24/7 Emergency Protocol (burst pipes, furnace failure in winter, gas smell instructions with 911 / Duke Energy utility contact numbers).
HawkVision Homes operating standards: proactive preventive maintenance, dignified tenant communication, transparent online ledgers, Cincinnati neighborhood stewardship, and zero-junk-fee leases.

Interactive switcher allowing Farouk and evaluators to preview all 8 PerchPoint roles (Farouk Owner, Nathan Platform Super Admin, Leasing Manager, Accounting Contractor, Maintenance Employee, Subcontractor, Primary Resident, Applicant) with real operational shells, permissions, and delegation cards.
Interactive viewer for the multidimensional delegation policy engine showing rule triggers, dollar limits, category filters, and audit review gates.
HawkVision Homes corporate footer with Fair Housing Equal Housing Opportunity emblem, Cincinnati emergency maintenance hotlines, demonstration disclosure, tenant resource links, and copyright.

testing_attributes.rule: Every button, link, tab, filter, modal trigger, and form input must have a kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Retain the established charcoal (#0D1117), obsidian cards, warm linen (#FAF8F5), and burnt copper (#C25E2B) color identity.
Completely eradicate the luxury sales brokerage copy: no million-dollar listings, no home valuation wizards, no VIP buyer quizzes, no fictional advisory agents.
Introduce the dual branding: HawkVision Homes on the public website with 'Powered by PerchPoint OS'; PerchPoint on the operating system shells.
Represent the full property hierarchy: Single-family, Duplex, Triplex, and Mixed-Use (demonstrating the 412 Elm building with 2 upper residential units and 1 ground-floor commercial bakery).

Provide interactive role previews for all 8 specific access roles requested: Farouk (Owner), Nathan (Platform Super Admin), Leasing Manager, Accounting Contractor, Maintenance Employee, Subcontractor, Primary Resident, Applicant.
Implement the multidimensional delegation policy matrix preview with configurable thresholds and reserved owner approvals.
Add explicit demonstration data markers: 'Demonstration Portfolio Data • Phase 0 Staging' on all stats and preview cards to adhere to the mandate.
Include high-visibility emergency maintenance protocols with Cincinnati utility contacts and clear non-emergency ticket submission.
Ensure all interactive components have explicit `data-testid` attributes.
